title: Vitrified basalt blocks at Kef Kalesi confirmed by Schoch
place_text: Kef Kalesi, near Lake Van, Turkey

tellings.quote: melting that has taken place literal melting of the stone and Dr Robert Shaw confirmed confirmed on numerous stones that it is indeed vitrification

plain: Basalt blocks at Kef Kalesi, an ancient site near Lake Van in Turkey, show "literal melting of the stone," according to Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient sites who says he examined them. He tells Michels that Dr. Robert Schoch confirmed on numerous stones that this is vitrification, meaning the stone was melted until it turned glassy. If he is right, the stones were once hit by intense heat that is hard to explain.
